reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I hate swallowing pills, and this is 2 capsules a day. Plus a new foil sachet every day feels like a lot of packaging waste for $25 to $30 a month on my budget.
objection: It's capsules, and I don't do pills. Two a day, every day, is a hard no for me, and the daily sachets are extra trash.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink-mix version of the same magnesium at a similar price, with the lab report still on the box.
